name: Liberty (Indiana, United States)
description: Royal blue field charged with a gold Statue of Liberty, the town's Lady Liberty.
history: Liberty is a town in and the county seat of Union County, Indiana, located about west of the state's border with Ohio. The flag was adopted on 28 August 1989 (adopted by the town council by ordinance 1989-6 of 28 August 1989 after a contest of the County Development Corporation, according to Flags of the World quoting the municipal code).
